summary: Event-driven Supervisor consumed the Run 11 allocation transition but Task 00 produced no worker request and only a Kanban projection before yielding.

data.root_cause: Task 00 Active is modeled as an observe-only transition in the new event dispatcher; the Supervisor tick returned worker_request=null and event-driven mode yielded after one boundary.
data.operational_impact: Run-only immediate stall with permanent control-plane implication; without same-execution recovery Task 00 would remain Active.
data.attempted_fix: Allowed the completed generation-1 GitHub owner to reach terminal state and its fence to expire; acquired generation 2 for the same execution and reconstructed readiness from protected evidence.
data.actual_fix: Complete Task 00 under generation 2, release the fence, and emit the Task 00 Done transition last so event-driven dispatch can advance Task 01.
data.timing_impact: Approximately eight minutes from protected allocation merge to generation-2 Task 00 recovery.
next_run_validation: Add a regression so Task 00 cannot yield from event-driven mode with worker_request=null unless Task 00 is already Done or a verified external blocker exists.

summary: Task 11 exhausted four native image attempts: three introduced non-allowlisted text and the fourth introduced recognizable logos despite a sealed no-extra-text/no-logo specification.

data.root_cause: The normal admission contract required byte-identical submission of the sealed prompt and provided no legal post-repair rendering overlay, while the generator repeatedly invented text-like or branded primitives.
data.operational_impact: Run-blocking image quality failure with permanent generator-delivery implication; Tasks 12-29 remain dependency-blocked until Task 11 is accepted_locked.
data.attempted_fix: Used all four normal bounded attempts with exact-byte persistence and saved-Git review; no fallback or owner workaround was used.
data.actual_fix: Protected repair epoch 1 adds a canonical machine-verifiable post-repair overlay banning all non-allowlisted characters, timestamps/CLI/metadata and recognizable logos, with neutral abstract substitutes only.
data.timing_impact: Task 11 blocked at 22:06 CT after four bounded attempts.
next_run_validation: Merge repair through exact-head CI, run one fresh-context post-repair attempt for only m01, and retain regression tests so arbitrary repair prompt edits remain inadmissible.
